narrative.overview:
Every screen is a record. A contracting request is not a card or a form — it is a document with legal weight, an audit trail, and a chain of custody. The visual system reflects this: clear hierarchies, unambiguous labels, and a surface that communicates institutional permanence without formality for its own sake.

The governing register is dense-and-scannable. Users open this app to advance work, not to explore. They land in the middle of a workflow and need to see where it stands, who is next, and what action is available to them.

This system explicitly rejects consumer SaaS aesthetics and the generic internal-tool look. The goal is earned familiarity — the interface disappears into the task.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces with structural borders, not shadows
Geist Sans at consistent sizes — no display type, no scale drama
Blue-600 accent reserved for primary actions and active states only
Mobile-first layout: critical workflow paths completable on 320px
State legibility above all: a solicitud's estado must be unmistakable at a glance

rules.name: The Azul Ingeniería Rule
rules.body: Blue-600 (#2563eb) appears on at most two elements per screen: the primary action button and the active navigation item. It must not appear in decorative contexts.

rules.name: The No Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: The background is #f9fafb, not a sand, cream, or tinted warm. Warmth comes from accurate status colors and purposeful density, not from background tint.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Geist Sans is the only typeface. No serif accent, no extra geometric sans, no display font for headings.

rules.name: The No Uppercase Body Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is prohibited in body copy and form labels. Permitted only for short badge labels (≤4 words).

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow on a card communicates interactive context cards don't have. Use border + background contrast instead.

dos: Do reserve Azul Ingeniería (#2563eb) for primary actions and active nav states only.
Do use estado badges as the primary status signal, pairing color with a short uppercase label.
Do keep cards flat: white background + #e5e7eb border, no shadow.
Do use 14px label-weight (500) for all button text, form labels, and nav items.
Do size tap targets at 44px minimum height for mobile.
Do complete all interactive states: default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading.
Do use #f9fafb as the page background and #ffffff for all content containers.
Do prefer inline forms and progressive disclosure over modals.
donts: Don't introduce a second typeface. Geist Sans is the only typeface.
Don't use the consumer SaaS aesthetic: large empty whitespace, oversized hero typography, playful illustration.
Don't use a warm, cream, or sand background. The background is #f9fafb, chroma 0.
Don't use the generic Bootstrap/Material visual language: navy headers, repeated icon+heading+text card grids.
Don't apply a shadow to an inline card or list item.
Don't use all-uppercase body copy or form labels.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient).
Don't put a colored left border (border-left > 1px) on cards, list items, or alerts.
